_INVALID: DO NOT USE. The supernet arm passed ABSOLUTE widths to set_width(), which takes an elastic FRACTION of the supernet's own width. The supernet was built at absolute width 0.50, so fractions 0.50/0.375/0.25 produced absolute widths 0.25/0.1875/0.125 -- roughly 3.5x smaller than the baselines they were compared against (see the params_M columns). The sandwich's max arm was also fraction 0.50, so the full supernet was never trained and the KD teacher was itself a sub-net. The +0.094 'OFA tax' this produced is meaningless.
_only_near_match: supernet frac-0.50 sub-net (2.827M, 0.5121) vs the width-0.25 baseline (2.572M, 0.5329): tax ~+0.021, and the sub-net is 10% LARGER while scoring lower, so size-matched it is somewhat worse. Suggestive of a real but moderate tax; still contaminated by the sub-net teacher.
_baselines_are_valid: The three baselines were trained independently at the correct absolute widths and ARE valid; only the supernet arm needs rerunning. Note their params_M were measured at the yaml default nc=80, not VOC's nc=20 -- cosmetic, does not affect mAP.
